text:
eva: Quick sync — follow-up from RFC on regional quarantine criteria and leader election. I sketched a simpler eviction + handoff flow to minimize cross-region writes for quarantined tenants. PTAL.

sam: Can you paste the flow? want to see edge cases.

eva: Sure — idea is local leader lease (short), handoff only when we detect permanent residency change or node drain. Handoff is 3-phase:
```
1) leader A -> PREPARE handoff to leader B (write intent)
2) leader B -> ACCEPT (acquires write lock + copies small delta)
3) leader A -> COMMIT (releases lease, updates global index)
```
We avoid copying whole KV unless checkpoint needed. Keeps latency low.

marco: How do we handle data residency: if tenant is 'quarantined' (can't leave region), B shouldn't be candidate.

eva: Exactly — quarantine flag in global control plane. Only candidate leaders in allowed region set. Handshake fails if region mismatch.

anya: Edge case: what if A becomes unreachable mid-handshake? we need TTL-based fallback and opaque epoch numbers.

jin: TTL + monotonic epoch ok. Also need a 'reclaim window' so stale leaders can't re-register. propose 30s reclaim for small tenants, longer for large.

sam: What about read path? serve locally always, but writes require leader check and might be forwarded to resident region. That adds p99 for writes.

eva: Tradeoff: fewer cross-region bulk moves vs slightly higher write tail. Suggest offer knob: 'aggressive-local' vs 'strict-residency'.

marco: Failure modes: network partition -> risk of split-brain if clocks skew. Add compare-and-set on global index updates and require majority acknowledgement from region nodes.

anya: Also need telemetry: emit events for handoff start/commit/fail + tenant quarantine reasons. ops can then audit.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: rcf-handshake-sim v1 -> canary to staging at 2026-03-15T10:12Z :white_check_mark:

eva: Next steps: I'll open an RFC PR with proto snippets and simulation plan. can folks comment on the reclaim window and knob defaults?

sam: +1 on 30s for default, but allow per-tenant override.

marco: prefer 45s default to be safe for intermittent infra hiccups.

anya: 30s ok for small, 120s for enterprise by default. we'll need GC for old checkpoints.

jin: I'll write the checkpoint compacting job proposal.

eva: thanks everyone. filing PR now. (👍)
